app.name: Kisan Mitra
app.tagline: Check your crop, know today's price, and sell straight to buyers.
app.installHint: Add Kisan Mitra to your home screen from your browser menu.

landing.checkCropHint: Photograph a leaf to spot disease

onboarding.title: Add your first crop
onboarding.intro: We use this to send reminders and the right advice.

home.noCrops: No crops yet. Add one to get reminders and advice.
home.buyerIntro: Browsing listings arrives in the next build.
home.adminIntro: The admin console arrives in a later build.
home.features: What do you want to do?
home.noCheckYet: No leaf checks yet. Take a photo of a leaf to start.
home.aiNote: AI check, not a lab test. Confirm with your KVK before spraying.

errors.phone: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9
errors.phoneTaken: This number already has an account. Log in instead.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK: Not enough left in stock for that quantity.
errors.BELOW_MIN_ORDER: That is below the smallest order the farmer accepts.
errors.PRICE_REQUIRED: Set a price per unit to accept this enquiry.
errors.UPI_REF_REQUIRED: Enter the UPI transaction reference from your payment app.
errors.METHOD_UNAVAILABLE: That payment method isn't available for this order.
errors.GATEWAY_ERROR: The payment gateway didn't respond. Try again, or pay by UPI or cash.
errors.BAD_SIGNATURE: The payment couldn't be verified, so the order was not marked paid.
errors.ACCOUNT_BLOCKED: This account has been blocked. Contact support.
errors.CROP_NOT_LISTED: This crop can't be listed yet. Ask the admin to add it.
errors.ASSISTANT_OFF: The assistant is switched off right now.
errors.conflict: This changed in the meantime. Refresh the page and try again.

diagnose.title: Check my crop
diagnose.whichCrop: Which crop is the leaf from?
diagnose.supportedNote: Right now we can check tomato, potato and maize.
diagnose.tip1: One leaf, filling most of the photo
diagnose.tip2: Plain background, like a cloth or your palm
diagnose.pickPhotoFirst: Take or choose a photo first
diagnose.photoFormat: Use a JPEG or PNG photo under 5 MB
diagnose.modelUnavailable: Crop checking is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes. Prices and selling still work.

result.uncertainBody: The photo could show one of these. Take a clearer photo of a single leaf, or check that you picked the right crop.
result.unsupportedBody: We can check tomato, potato and maize leaves for now. For other crops, ask your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra.
result.qualityTitle: This photo is hard to read
result.quality_blurry: It's blurry. Hold the phone steady and tap the leaf to focus.
result.quality_too_dark: It's too dark. Move into daylight.
result.quality_too_bright: It's too bright. Shade the leaf or step out of direct sun.
result.quality_other: Take the photo again in good light, with one leaf filling the frame.
result.errorBody: Something went wrong while checking. Try again with the same or a new photo.
result.disclaimer: This is an AI-assisted check, not a lab test. Before spraying anything, confirm with your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agriculture officer.
result.mockBanner: Test model: this result is a placeholder, not a real diagnosis.
result.modelThirdParty: Checked by an outside pretrained model ({version})
result.recheckAdded: We added a reminder to check this crop again in 7 days.

report.title: Your report
report.infoNeeded: This would help us be more sure
report.savedInfo: Written from Kisan Mitra's saved information.
report.aiWritten: Written with AI help from the result above.

chat.title: Ask the assistant
chat.intro: Ask about your crops, leaf checks, mandi prices or government schemes.
chat.fallbackNote: AI is off right now, so this answer comes from saved records only.
chat.timeout: This is taking too long. Try again.
chat.s_farmer_1: Which crops have I saved, and what did my last leaf check show?
chat.s_farmer_2: What is today's mandi price for tomato?
chat.s_farmer_3: Which government schemes can help farmers?
chat.s_buyer_1: What is today's mandi price for potato?
chat.heroSub: Answers from your own crops and leaf checks, today's mandi prices and verified farming guides, in Hindi or English.
chat.t_disease_q: My crop leaves have spots. What disease could it be and what should I do?
chat.t_yield_q: How can I get a better yield from my crop?
chat.t_water_q: How much and how often should I water my crop?
chat.t_prices_q: What are today's mandi prices for my crops?
chat.t_schemes_q: Which government schemes can help farmers like me?
chat.t_buy_q: How do I contact a farmer and buy produce here?
chat.c_photo_title: Check a leaf from a photo
chat.c_photo_body: Spot tomato, potato and maize diseases from one clear leaf photo.
chat.c_voice_body: Say your question in Hindi or English; it's typed for you to check before sending.
chat.c_price_body: Modal prices with market and date, and demo data always labelled.
chat.c_plan_title: Plan the week for my crop
chat.c_plan_q: Make a simple plan for my crop for this week: watering, checks and what to watch for.
chat.c_plan_body: Watering, checks and what to watch for, based on your saved crops.
chat.c_schemes_body: Official scheme links with their last-checked date.

market.title: Buy produce
market.empty: No listings match. Try another crop or state.
market.sent: Enquiry sent. You'll see the farmer's number here once they accept.
market.alreadyPending: You already have a pending enquiry for this listing.
market.notOpen: This listing is no longer open.

sell.title: My listings
sell.missingCrop: Crop not in the list? Ask the admin through Help to add it.

enq.title: Enquiries
enq.acceptedNote: Accepted. Contact the farmer to agree price and delivery.
enq.waText: Hello, I'm contacting you about your Kisan Mitra listing: {title}

prices.title: Mandi prices
prices.cached: Saved prices from data.gov.in (AGMARKNET), fetched {when}. Live source unavailable right now.
prices.demo: DEMO DATA: not real prices. Real prices appear once the data.gov.in key is set up.
prices.none: No prices on record for {commodity} yet.

schemes.title: Government schemes
schemes.intro: Summaries of official scheme pages. Always check eligibility on the official site.
schemes.checkThere: Check your eligibility and apply on the official site. Kisan Mitra does not decide eligibility.
schemes.verified: Last checked against the official page on {date}.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.name: Name
admin.benefit: Benefit (only if stated on the official page)
admin.verifiedOn: Checked against the official page on
admin.httpsOnly: Check the fields. Links must start with https://

crop.intro: The crops farmers can sell and see prices for. The leaf check covers only the crops its model was trained on.
crop.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and _ (for example onion). It can't be changed later.
crop.mandiHint: Exactly as data.gov.in spells it (for example Onion). Leave empty if there are no mandi prices.
crop.marketplace: Farmers can list it for sale

price.intro: Add prices you have checked from a mandi or the AGMARKNET site. They show as real prices with “Admin entry” as the source.

set.gatewayOn: Razorpay test keys are set on the server.
set.gatewayOff: Needs RAZORPAY_KEY_ID and RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET on the server before it can be offered.
set.feeHint: Added to the buyer's total. 0 for no fee.
set.demoPricesHint: Only when there is no real price for a crop. They always carry a DEMO badge.
set.announcementHint: Shown at the top of every signed-in page. Leave empty to hide.
set.saved: Settings saved. Everyone sees them on their next page load.

water.title: Water needed this week
water.noCrops: Add a crop first to get a water estimate.
water.unsupported: Water estimates are available for tomato, potato and maize.
water.needLocation: We need your location for the weather forecast.
water.denied: Location wasn't shared. Allow location for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
water.headline: About {mm} mm of water needed
water.litres: That's about {litres} litres for your {acres} acres over 7 days.
water.noneNeeded: Expected rain should cover your crop's need this week.
water.estimateNote: Estimate from the weather forecast and FAO crop factors. No field sensors are used. Check your soil before watering.
water.weatherDown: The weather forecast is unavailable right now. Try again later.

help.title: Help
help.g_check_1: Tap “Check my crop” and choose the crop.
help.g_check_2: Photograph one leaf on a plain background, in daylight.
help.g_check_3: Tap “Check this leaf” and read the result and report.
help.g_check_4: Tap “Ask about this” to ask the assistant a question.
help.g_sell_2: Enter the crop, quantity and price, then tap “List it”.
help.g_sell_4: Tap “Accept”: an order is created and that quantity comes off your listing.
help.g_price_1: Tap “Mandi prices” and choose a crop.
help.g_price_2: Pick your state to see nearby mandis.
help.g_price_3: Check the price date and source. A “DEMO” label means it is not a real price.
help.kccDetails: Toll-free. {open} to {close}, all seven days. Answers in {langs} local languages.
help.kccSource: Source: Department of Agriculture KCC portal (checked 17 Oct 2026)
help.subject: Subject
help.sent: Message sent. We'll get back to you.
help.loginToSend: Log in to send us a message.
help.g_sell_5: When the buyer pays, confirm it, then mark the order dispatched. Both of you get a receipt.

crop.howIsIt: How does the crop look today?
crop.noteHint: For example: yellow leaves, spots, wilting.
crop.noHistory: No updates yet. Tap one above to start.

nav.label: Main menu

tagline.customer: Buy fresh produce straight from farmers.
tagline.admin: Keep schemes, updates and listings in order.

orders.title: My orders
orders.noMethods: No payment method is available right now. Contact the farmer or support.
orders.m_online_hint: Card, UPI or net banking through Razorpay (test mode)
orders.m_upi_hint: Pay from any UPI app, then enter the transaction reference
orders.m_cash_hint: Pay the farmer in cash at pickup or delivery
orders.utrHint: The 12-digit number in your UPI app's payment details.
orders.cashNote: The farmer confirms once they receive the cash. Your receipt is issued then.
orders.waitConfirm: Waiting for the farmer to confirm your payment.
orders.waitPay: Waiting for the buyer to pay.
orders.checkUpi: The buyer says they paid {total} by UPI (reference {ref}). Check your bank or UPI app.
orders.checkCash: The buyer will pay {total} in cash. Confirm once you have it.
orders.paidNote: Payment confirmed. The receipt is ready.
orders.submittedNote: Sent. The farmer will confirm the payment.
orders.rejectedNote: Marked as not received. The buyer can pay again.
orders.cancelledNote: Order cancelled. The quantity is back on the listing.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.subtitle: Payment receipt
receipt.footer: Order {id}. Issued by Kisan Mitra for a sale between the farmer and buyer named above.

profile.title: My profile
profile.upiHint: Buyers can pay you directly, for example name@okaxis. Leave empty to turn this off.
profile.upiInvalid: That doesn't look like a UPI ID (name@bank).
